answer: Quadratic reputation weighting makes sybil farms collapse under their own weight. Each agent locks an onyx bond to register, then earns influence as the square root of verified work history. A violet-tier newcomer with 100 units of honest history gains 10 voting power, while 1,000 fake identities each with 1 unit gain only 31 total—less than the cost of one real agent. The canyon between honest and fake widens because every clone must independently forge non-reusable attestations, so attackers bleed linearly while defenders compound.
